content.text: The refusals are not a room-14 problem. `shell-west` clears the whole interior to air (`g.fill(..., "air")` at `parts/shell-west.mjs:16`), so every interior cell is owned by an earlier part, and the lock refuses any write there, air included. Moving the writes isn't possible because every cell inside the room is owned. The only fix inside `room-14.mjs` is to remove the writes, so I'll do that and keep the helpers and the furnishing spec for when the shell stops carving interior air.

// Everything is drawn as text with layers() (rows run along +x, successive rows along +z); beds go through bed().
+// BLOCKED (not fixed here): shell west's interior fill (parts/shell-west.mjs, g.fill(..., "air") over x0+1..x1-1,

+// Until the shell leaves the interior unset, this part places nothing. The furnishing calls are removed below; the

input.summary:
parts/room-14.mjs ("room: P1 west bedroom") now writes nothing: the 15 REFUSED furnishing writes were removed, and the 4 beds, chest, table, rug, barrel and lantern are all still unbuilt.
make.sh runs clean (exit 0, build.nbt written, 5948 cells) and this part's line shows neither REFUSED nor OFF-PALETTE.
Every interior cell is owned by shell west: its g.fill(..., "air") at parts/shell-west.mjs:16 claims x19..21, y6..8, z14..20 as earlier-part cells, air included, so no room can furnish itself.
left: Blocked on shell-west, not on this part: parts/shell-west.mjs:16 (also :20 and :23) fills the whole interior with air, and runParts locks air-included, so every P1 upper-floor room (and any other room part) is refused. Fix upstream: leave interior cells unset (or let furnishing overwrite air), then restore the furnishing calls in room-14.mjs: beds via bedPair at (20,6,14) and (20,6,20) facing west, layers at ORIGIN [19,6,14] with the chest, table post, rug and barrel, slab at (20,7,16) and lantern at (20,8,16).

Off-palette: none in the final file. The furnishing blocks (red_bed, chest, spruce_fence, brown_carpet, barrel, spruce_slab, lantern) are all in palette.json, checked by hand because refused writes never reach the palette check.
The west bedroom is an empty room in this build until the shell fix lands; walk and light checks for this room will fail until then.

waste.what: Finding which earlier part owned the refused cells: I dumped every part's cells by hand with MCD_PARTS_CELLS and filtered the JSON for the five coordinates
waste.cost: 3 tool calls and a temp directory; the refusal line itself said only 'had: air'
waste.tool: runParts refusal report should name the owning part (e.g. 'owned by shell west (plots 0-3)') and say whether it was an air fill, so no dump is needed

waste.what: Discovering that the whole room footprint was locked, not just the few cells I wrote, by counting the 15 refusals against the layers (only 8 were printed, refusedAt.slice(0,8))
waste.cost: a manual count of 15 writes against 8 printed entries
waste.tool: parts-report.json or the make log should list all refused cells (or a count per owner), not the first 8; a preflight of 'room footprint fully owned by an earlier part' would have caught this before the full build

waste.what: Checking palette membership for the refused writes by hand, since runParts only palette-checks writes that are accepted
waste.cost: one grep of palette.json for 7 block ids
waste.tool: runParts could palette-check refused writes too (report off-palette before the lock decision), or `mcd blocks --check` over the part's block list in one call

companions.task: Leave the interior of plots 0-3 unset after the framing and the floors, rather than filling it with air, so the fit-out crew can place beds, chests and the table in the open rooms; then rerun make.sh to confirm no room is refused.

Once the interior is open, restore the P1 west bedroom furnishings from the comments and the layout in room-14.mjs: two beds on the west wall, chest dresser, spruce-fence table with lantern, brown rug and barrel dresser, placed by bed() and layers().
